headline: Better Money Decisions for Millennials
summary: Member acquisition against multinationals and online banks. “Adulting is hard, Centra makes it easier” — and millennial membership rose 20%.

question.h: Winning young members against big banks.
question.p: Member acquisition and retention can be challenging for a credit union — even a heavyweight like Centra — and especially with competition from multinationals and online banking services.

made.h: Adulting is hard — Centra makes it easier.
made.p: We encouraged millennials to make better money decisions by making finance a little hip. Video, outdoor, social, even in-branch POS and activations reminded young prospects while “Adulting is hard, Centra makes it easier.” Segmentation drove message clarity and efficiency.

happened.h: A flurry of inquiries, 20% more millennial members.
happened.p: The result: a flurry of inquiries and a whopping 20% increase in millennial membership.
